name: Toshima (Tokyo, Japan, village)
description: A white field charged at the centre with the Toshima village emblem in blue: a disc bearing white curved strokes forming a stylised swirl.
history: Municipal flag of Toshima, a village in Tokyo; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 1 October 1985.

features.role: Toshima village emblem — a disc bearing white curved strokes forming a stylised swirl
